messages:
maya: Heads up — getting multiple LCP + chart-paint alerts from EU console after the 12:15 canary. Heatmaps and sparklines hang for ~5-8s. Dashboard link: https://console.redwood.dev/d/abc/perf?from=now-15m

jonathan: seeing same in prod. Repro locally with ?region=eu shows heavy main thread during chart render. Flamegraph attached (paste):
```
main  78%  renderCharts
  parseData 42%
  drawCanvas 30%
```

sami: I pushed telemetry size bump + new routing header change in the runtime yesterday (rollout 12:10). Could be related. The bundle increased by ~120KB gzipped (source maps growing) — maybe chart lib now loaded earlier.

lucy: we did enable telemetry sampling with full payload for canary, that might be sending large arrays to console. Also noticed KV cache misses spike in tracing: route affinity changed so requests bypassed edge cache.

maya: timeline: 12:10 rollout, 12:15 alerts, so likely correlated. Can we quick rollback the rollout? Any short mitigations? :pray: 

deploy-bot: Canary deployment 2026-03-20T12:09:57Z started for service=console-client tag=canary-telemetry-20260320.

jonathan: quick hotfix idea: lazy-load heavy chart renderer (import('plot-series')) at user interaction instead of initial paint. Patch is tiny:
```
const render = async (data) => {
  const { Plot } = await import('./plot-series');
  return Plot.render(data);
}
```
Should reduce initial bundle parse and block. Can we ship a canary patch in 30m?

sami: sounds fine. But if KV cache misses are due to header change we'll still see backend latency. I can revert the routing header in infra flags and re-run small canary for that change only.

lucy: telemetry team — can you throttle full-payload sampling to 1% for canary? That'd immediately cut payload size.

prod-telemetry-bot: Sampling policy updated: full_payload_sampling=0.01 for canary cohort.

jonathan: I'll open a PR for lazy-load and a small CSS skeleton to avoid layout shift. If QA passes we can push to canary in 25m and watch LCP.

eng-sre: can we add a short-term alert to mute pager but notify channel on LCP crossing 3s so we don't wake up everyone? Also add KV cache miss rate graph to the dashboard.

maya: agreed. After that we decide: rollback canary-telemetry or proceed with lazy-load + routing header revert. If lazy-load fixes 90% of LCP we can keep telemetry change gated.

sami: I'm starting the header revert canary now.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment 2026-03-20T12:35:12Z started for service=console-client tag=revert-routing-header-20260320.

jonathan: update — local test with lazy-load cuts initial parse by ~70% and LCP by 1.8s. Pushing PR: https://git.redwood/console-client/pulls/4123

maya: awesome. Let's coordinate rollout order: header revert first, then lazy-load patch, then telemetry sampling revert final if needed. Keep this channel updated. :thumbsup: 

lucy: noted. I'll monitor telemetry payloads and KV miss rate.

maya: thanks all. I'll own postmortem if this was our rollout mistake.
